summary: Iteration 2 testing complete. Backend: 33/33 pytest cases pass (16 new + 17 iter-1 regressions). Chat rules enforced: message blocked before claim (400 'chat opens after a handyman claims'), blocked after claim but before T-24h (400 '24h before work time'), unlocked immediately for emergency after claim. GET /api/jobs/{id}/chat-status returns {allowed,reason,address_release_at}. Contact-info filter rejects phone (555-123-4567, 5551234567), email (test@example.com), street address (123 Main Street) with 400. Allowed benign text goes through 200. Commission fully hidden: /payments/mine strips 'commission', 'commission_cents_planned', 'application_fee_amount' for both customers and handymen; /earnings/summary returns only NET total (no commission field); admin viewer keeps commission (verified via /admin/jobs). Full emergency lifecycle math verified: $200 job → handyman payout amount=180.00 (10% commission of $20 retained platform-side, hidden from users). /api/upload multipart returns {path,url,storage} with storage='inline' (Emergent proxy unreachable in this env — acceptable fallback). Job photos endpoint works for post/before/after; before-photo gate on /start enforced (tv_mounting). /stripe/onboard returns {url,...}; /stripe/status returns {connected,charges_enabled,payouts_enabled,details_submitted}. Non-owner non-handyman handyman gets 403 on completed job; owner still 200. Login accepts any captcha_token ≥6 chars including 'hold_1200_abc_xyz'. Frontend (390x844 mobile viewport): login screen shows 'Press & hold to verify' (no math). Holding ~1.2s transitions to green 'Human verified' pill; Sign in becomes enabled and routes customer to /home. Customer bottom tab bar shows 5 icons (Home / Jobs / Messages / Payments / Profile). Job detail page shows single big color-coded 'Current status' card ('Awaiting a pro' seen) — full step list absent. Send-message icon correctly hidden on POSTED job (chat locked). Handyman bottom tabs: Find Jobs (radar) / My Jobs (wrench) / Messages / Earnings / Profile. Find Jobs default view is the animated radar with concentric rings (15/30/60), 'You'/'Emergency' legend, pins with prices, and a radar↔list toggle. Handyman Profile shows animated ID VERIFIED / TRUSTED PRO / TOP RATED badges. Payouts card shows 'Payouts active — Powered by Stripe' (mike is already onboarded via mock; the pre-onboard 'Connect payouts' button path was not exercised because mike is seeded connected). One console error surfaced from radar-view (negative <circle> r on animation tick) — visual glitch only, does not affect functionality.

ui_bugs.issue: SVG <circle> receives negative r values on some animation frames ('Error: <circle> attribute r: A negative value is not valid'). Console errors on every sweep cycle. Reference: /app/frontend/src/radar-view.tsx:31-34 — sweepProps r=sweep.value*(size/2-6) can go slightly negative due to reanimated interpolation on web. Fix: clamp with Math.max(0, ...).
Missing testID='radar-view' on the outer wrapper and testIDs 'toggle-radar'/'toggle-list' on the top-right radar↔list toggle buttons — reduces testability.

issues: ZIP row is masked as '921**' even for the owner while the full address ('123 Test St, San Diego, CA 92105') is shown right below. Consider showing the full ZIP to owners for consistency.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Widespread across screens. Reference: multiple components under /app/frontend/app/ and /app/frontend/src/ using StyleSheet with shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius. Migrate to RN 0.76+ boxShadow.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — appeared on profile screen. Grep components using pointerEvents prop and move to style.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 1727 lines — still monolithic. Consider modular split (auth, jobs, chat, payments, stripe, uploads, admin) before iteration 3.

Chat filter _detect_contact_info uses 'if len(digits)>=10' — will falsely match any message containing 10+ total digits (e.g. 'I have 10 chairs and 20 tables and 100 hooks and 50 nails' = 6 digits so ok, but 'order 1234567890 items' = 10 digits will block). Acceptable trade-off but consider requiring digit clustering.

_can_chat correctly enforces: not-yet-claimed → 'chat opens after a handyman claims the job'; before release_at → 'chat opens 24h before work time'; emergency jobs release address immediately so chat opens on claim.

PaymentService applies 10% commission consistently; _strip_commission_for(role) hides commission/commission_cents_planned/application_fee_amount for non-admin. /earnings/summary returns only NET (no commission key) — verified.
GET /jobs/{id} correctly returns 403 for unrelated handymen once job leaves POSTED/MATCHING_* states, protecting completed-job privacy.
Upload endpoint gracefully falls back to inline mongo storage when Emergent proxy is unreachable (observed in this env). /api/files/{path} requires auth via bearer header or ?token= query.

rca_of_issue: RadarView negative-radius warning: reanimated's sweep.value is interpolated on web and can produce a tiny negative float on the wrap-around frame (repeat=-1). SVG rejects negative r. Reproduction: open handyman /available in web and observe DevTools console every 3.5s. Mitigation: clamp with Math.max(0, sweep.value*(size/2-6)) inside useAnimatedProps.
